meta.name: meta-ads-campaign-builder
meta.description: End-to-end Meta Ads campaign builder for Facebook and Instagram. Takes ICP + objective, generates audience targeting recommendations, ad set structure, copy framework per placement, and exports as a campaign brief or structured CSV. Focused on campaign architecture, not creative generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据目标客户画像和营销目标，自动生成Meta广告系列架构与投放策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速搭建Facebook和Instagram广告系列结构
copy.tagline_en: Generate Meta ad campaign architecture and targeting strategy from ICP and objective
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly structure Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你提供的产品信息、目标受众和预算，自动生成一套完整的 Meta 广告（Facebook/Instagram）投放方案，包括受众定位、广告组结构、各版位文案框架，并输出为营销计划文档或 CSV。
howto.when: 当你提出“搭建 Meta 广告”、“设置 Facebook 广告”、“创建 Instagram 广告活动”等需求，或要求为产品/活动规划广告时触发。

say.text: 帮我搭建一个 Meta 广告活动，推广我们的 SaaS 产品。
say.note: Claude 会引导你提供产品名、目标、预算等信息。

say.text: 为我们的新品发布规划 Facebook 广告。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含受众、文案、预算的完整方案。

say.text: 我想在 Instagram 上投放广告，从哪里开始？
say.note: Claude 会询问 ICP、目标等，然后输出广告架构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate a complete Meta Ads campaign plan (Facebook/Instagram) based on your product, target audience, and budget, including audience targeting, ad set structure, copy framework per placement, and export as a campaign brief or CSV.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'build a Meta Ads campaign', 'set up Facebook Ads', 'create an Instagram ad campaign', or request ad planning for a product/launch.

say_en.text: Build a Meta Ads campaign for our SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for product name, objective, budget, etc.

say_en.text: Plan a Facebook campaign for our product launch.
say_en.note: Claude will output a full plan with audiences, copy, and budget.

say_en.text: I want to run Instagram ads, where do I start?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through ICP, objective, and structure.
